title: Flanger speed in sync with the tempo (FL02)
author: naturarum
description: EXPERIMENT: emulator-tested only. For dn2-cfw's FL02 build, whose DSP runs a flanger in the chorus slot: FUNC + turn on the chorus page's SPD (knob B) steps through 12 speeds in sync with the project tempo, one LFO cycle per 16, 8, 4, 2 or 1 bars, 1/2, 1/4., 1/4, 1/8., 1/8, 1/16 or 1/32 note, named as the delay names its note values; a turn without FUNC goes back to the free speeds. As the delay's FUNC + turn works: the row's display entry gets its own FUNC + turn function, and its value text names the synced values. A synced speed is kept in the knob's own value (a low byte, as the delay's fine values), so it is saved with the kit and nothing else is stored; old kits keep their free speed. On a DSP without sync a synced value plays about that speed at 120 BPM.
